owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_STATE_AGE().notice: Maximum age for state data (1 hour in blocks)

MAX_VALIDATORS().notice: Maximum number of validators per state update

MIN_CONSENSUS_VALIDATORS().notice: Minimum number of validators required for consensus

checkConsensus(bytes32).notice: Check if consensus is reached for a state hash

consensusResults(bytes32).notice: Mapping of state hash to consensus result

getValidationResults(bytes32).notice: Get validation results for a state hash

operatorStats(address).notice: Mapping of operator to validation stats

registeredOperators(address).notice: Mapping of operator to registered status

stateValidations(bytes32,uint256).notice: Mapping of state hash to validation results

validationCounts(bytes32).notice: Mapping of state hash to validation count
